title: To-do list
goal: Build a to-do list web app. The page has a text input with the placeholder "New task", a button labelled "Add", and a list of the stored tasks below them. Tasks are stored on the server, each with a title. Clicking Add stores a new task with the typed title and shows it in the list. Tasks that are already stored are shown when the page loads. Tasks are kept when the server restarts.
